import * as y from './src/src/index.ts'
const cases = [
  ['first-tab', 'k: >
  	first
  normal
'],
  ['last-tab', 'k: >
  normal
  	last
'],
  ['middle-tab', 'k: >
  first
  	middle
  last
'],
  ['long-tab', `k: >
  	${'long words '.repeat(12)}end
  next
`],
  ['ordinary-space-tab', `k: >
  ${'word '.repeat(12)} 	${'tail '.repeat(12)}end
`],
  ['ordinary-long', `k: >
  ${'ordinary words '.repeat(20)}
`],
  ['literal-tab', 'k: |
  	first
  	last
'],
  ['blank-chomp', 'k: >+
  first

  	last

']
]
for (const [name, source] of cases) {
  const events = y.parseEvents(source, {})
  const docs = y.eventsToAst(events, {source, schema:y.CORE_SCHEMA})
  const before = y.load(source).k
  const presented = y.present(docs, {schema:y.CORE_SCHEMA})
  const after = y.load(presented).k
  if (before !== after) throw new Error(`${name}: ${JSON.stringify(before)} != ${JSON.stringify(after)}
${presented}`)
  console.log(`${name}: ok (${JSON.stringify(before)})`)
}

node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import * as y from './src/src/index.ts'
const cases = [
  ['first tab', 'k: >\n  \tfirst\n  normal\n', true],
  ['last tab', 'k: >\n  normal\n  \tlast\n', true],
  ['middle tab', 'k: >\n  first\n  \tmiddle\n  last\n', true],
  ['long tab line', `k: >\n  \t${'long words '.repeat(12)}end\n  next\n`, true],
  ['space before tab near wrap', `k: >\n  ${'x'.repeat(39)} \t${'word '.repeat(16)}end\n`, true],
  ['ordinary long line', `k: >\n  ${'ordinary words '.repeat(20)}\n`, true],
  ['literal tab lines', 'k: |\n  \tfirst\n  \tlast\n', false],
  ['blank lines and keep chomping', 'k: >+\n  first\n\n  \tlast\n\n', true]
]
for (const [name, source, folded] of cases) {
  const docs = y.eventsToAst(y.parseEvents(source, {}), {source, schema:y.CORE_SCHEMA})
  const scalar = docs[0].contents.items.find(({key}) => key.value === 'k').value
  assert.equal(scalar.style.folded, folded, `${name}: AST style`)
  assert.equal(scalar.style.literal, !folded, `${name}: AST style`)
  for (const lineWidth of [20, 80]) {
    const text = y.present(docs, {schema:y.CORE_SCHEMA, lineWidth})
    assert.equal(text.includes('>'), folded, `${name}: emitted style at width ${lineWidth}`)
    assert.equal(text.includes('|'), !folded, `${name}: emitted style at width ${lineWidth}`)
    assert.deepEqual(y.load(text), y.load(source), `${name}: value at width ${lineWidth}`)
  }
  console.log(`${name}: passed`)
}

final:
Updated `src/src/ast/presenter.ts` so folded-scalar presentation treats tab-leading lines as more-indented and avoids wrapping immediately before a tab. This preserves folded/literal styles and round-trip values without changing public APIs.

Verified:
- `SUFFICE_WORKSPACE="$PWD" node --test tests/visible.test.mjs` — all 7 tests passed.
- Public parseEvents → eventsToAst → present round trips passed for tab-leading lines, long lines, space-before-tab wrap points, literal style, and blank-line/chomping cases.
